title: OneDrive: odcli command-line tool for the sync app
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned command-line tool and March CY2027 target without presenting them as released functionality. Its OneDrive licensing background is documented, and independent searches found no odcli documentation resolving the controls, installation, permissions or default-state questions it identifies.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a new command-line tool named odcli for the OneDrive sync app.
claims.quote: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line.
